versions.changelog: Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Version bump from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1.
- Documentation updates in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md.
- No changes to functionality or usage instructions.

- Added instructions for the new dlazy CLI device-code login flow using dlazy login, making API key setup easier.
- Updated authentication section to recommend dlazy login as the default method.
- Manual API key configuration instructions moved to an alternative option.
- No changes to usage, parameters, or API behavior.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated to version 1.0.2.
- Improved instructions for API key handling and storage.
- Clarified agent instructions for handling unauthorized errors.
- No changes to CLI options or core functionality.

- Added detailed authentication instructions, including how to obtain and set the dLazy API key.
- Updated installation instructions to require @dlazy/cli version 1.0.6.
- Improved documentation for initial setup and API usage.

Initial release of dlazy-seedance-1.5-pro.

- Converts images into dynamic dance videos using Doubao Seedance 1.5 Pro.
- Command-line interface with options for prompt, image input, resolution, aspect ratio, duration, and audio generation.
- Supports both local and remote image sources.
- Includes detailed error handling for missing API keys, insufficient balance, and parameter errors.
- Provides user instructions and sample commands for generating dance videos.
